sentences.en: To Americans, a Japanese baby seems to have no privacy.
sentences.zh: 对美国人来说，日本婴儿似乎没有隐私。

sentences.en: People usually become famous at the cost of their privacy.
sentences.zh: 人们通常会为了成名而牺牲自己的隐私。

sentences.en: The flimsy stalls in this restroom offer very little privacy.
sentences.zh: 这个洗手间的简陋隔间提供的私密性几乎为零。

senses.zh: 隐居, (不受干扰的)独处 - 私事, 隐私
